game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Wind Pass, a howling mountain pass: the summit pilot must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Vowel Counter: Count vowels in words by looping over characters.
theme: Frost Peaks – Wind Pass: a howling mountain pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Wind Pass, repeat each round: Count vowels in words by looping over characters. Each round, avalanches strike the cliff anchor, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the vowels value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cliff anchor from avalanches in Wind Pass: keep the vowels meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: vowels drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 6 (applied tier): Vowel Counter
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Vowel Counter' (Week 8 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Wind Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

code_snippet:
for ch in word:
    if ch in 'aeiou':
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vowels changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Wind Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while vowels > 0.
